newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's 1996 PSBR estimated at 138.50 trln lire.
newsitem.headline: Italy's 1996 PSBR estimated at 138.50 trln lire.

text.p: Italy's cumulative public sector borrowing requirement was a provisional 138.50 trillion lire at end-December 1996 compared with 130.20 trillion in 1995, the Treasury Ministry said in a statement.
It said the PSBR for the month of December was 3.20 trillion lire compared with a surplus of 6.20 trillion in the same month of 1995.
The preliminary figure for 1996 compared with an official government target of 123.00 trillion lire for the full year.
